        if isinstance(v, str) and v.strip():
            return v.strip()
    # if numeric or something, skip
    v = ws_task[f"D{row}"].value
    return '' if v is None else str(v)

label_map = {}

    label_map[r] = label

    print(r, ':', repr(label_map[r]))

    # Fallback: if label exactly empty, leave alone

    for c in range(column_index_from_string('H'), column_index_from_string('L')+1):

        f = stat_formula_for_label(col, label)

                    problem_hits.append((r, get_column_letter(c), 'embedded_error', v))

print('\nProblematic formula text hits:', len(problem_hits))

    v = ws3[addr].value
    print(addr, '=>', v)
    if isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith('#'):
        print('  WARNING: cached error value')
